title: ~/.gemini/agents/filename.md is not recognized as an agent if filename.md is a symlink

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly reports a bug where subagent definition markdown files (*.md) located in agent directories (e.g., ~/.gemini/agents/) are not recognized if they are symbolic links. Clear reproduction details and expectations are provided.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix requires a localized update in packages/core/src/agents/agentLoader.ts (and packages/core/src/services/FolderTrustDiscoveryService.ts) to check entry.isSymbolicLink() in addition to entry.isFile() when scanning directory entries, along with a simple unit test.

summary.problem: Subagent markdown files in agent directories (such as ~/.gemini/agents/) are not recognized or loaded if the file is a symbolic link.
summary.root_cause: loadAgentsFromDirectory in packages/core/src/agents/agentLoader.ts checks entry.isFile() on fs.readdir Dirent objects. Node.js Dirent.isFile() returns false for symbolic links, causing symlinked agent files to be filtered out.
summary.context: Users frequently store agent configuration files in a central directory (e.g., dotfiles) and symlink them into ~/.gemini/agents/. Supporting symlinks allows these custom subagents to be properly detected.

steps: In packages/core/src/agents/agentLoader.ts, update loadAgentsFromDirectory so that the file filtering check accepts symlinks via (entry.isFile() || entry.isSymbolicLink()).
In packages/core/src/services/FolderTrustDiscoveryService.ts, update discoverAgents to also check (entry.isFile() || entry.isSymbolicLink()) when identifying agent files.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Symlinked agent markdown files in an agents directory should be loaded as valid agent definitions.
verification_steps: Add a test case under loadAgentsFromDirectory in packages/core/src/agents/agentLoader.test.ts that creates a valid agent markdown file outside or inside the test folder, creates a symlink pointing to it with a .md extension, and verifies that loadAgentsFromDirectory successfully parses and returns the agent.
